metadataReview.note: Reviewed location: Haryana Tourism states that Taraori, a small town in Karnal district, was the battleground of two decisive battles between Prithviraj Chauhan and Muhammad Ghori in 1191 and 1192. The cited Wikipedia revision identifies Tarain with modern Taraori. The point is the gazetteer position of Taraori town. It is a town reference for a battle fought near it, not a surveyed battlefield, a camp or any army position, and Haryana Tourism attributes the 1192 battle to the same town. The existing year-precision date is retained. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.
